notes.text: Keep the repro: record what you do, play it back later.
Session tab — records your clicks and typing, plays them back. Agents can do the same over MCP.
Checks — mark what should be true; the build server replays and fails when it isn't.
Fixed the 3D view — layers sat in the wrong place, text read mirrored.
Clicks from the tool no longer miss — they landed on nothing right after the screen changed.
Dragging starts where you pressed — sliders ended up at the wrong value.
Search no longer finds our own marker — the label the tool draws over your app.
